title: The Olive Oil Polyphenol Index: Every Brand That Publishes Its Polyphenol Numbers (2026/27)
seoTitle: The Olive Oil Polyphenol Index (2026/27): Every Brand That Publishes Its Numbers
excerpt: Very few olive oil producers publish their polyphenol content. This index lists every brand that does — with the measured values, the analysis method, and whether the lab report is viewable. Unranked, because numbers from different methods are different currencies.
seoDescription: Every olive oil brand that publishes its polyphenol numbers, in one index: totals, oleocanthal, oleacein, analysis method and lab reports — and why figures from different labs can't be compared directly.
